screening_reasoning: A super-resolution + Mamba/CNN semantic-segmentation framework assesses blueberry maturity (mIoU 83.15%); although genuine DL pixel segmentation, the domain is orchard-fruit (blueberry) maturity, not crop/weed segmentation.

VIT-GWO combines a Vision Transformer feature extractor with Grey Wolf optimization for crop leaf-disease detection/classification on PlantVillage (99.21% precision); a classification task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

A CNN-BiLSTM with attention fuses UAV multispectral and IoT soil data to predict nutrient stress and pest-related conditions (MAE ~0.53); a regression/classification monitoring task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

YOLOv8-Seg performs instance segmentation of individual Chinese cabbage plants from UAV multispectral imagery (mAP 86.3%, SAM-assisted annotation), extracting crop count and leaf area; DL crop pixel-segmentation on UAV imagery with quantitative mask metrics.

A comparison of object-detection models (YOLOv8n, YOLOv5n, Faster R-CNN, Deformable DETR) for counting maize seedlings from UAV imagery (AP50 up to 0.976); a detection/counting task, not pixel-level crop segmentation.

An ongoing study trains YOLO, Faster R-CNN, and SSD object detectors to detect/localize weeds in a strawberry field from UAV altitude; an object-detection task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

A general AI system using CNNs on drone/automated-robot crop images to detect/classify field pests and weeds; a detection/classification study without a specific crop/weed pixel-segmentation benchmark.

A comparison of YOLOv5, YOLO-NAS, and Mask R-CNN for weed detection in tropical conditions reports accuracy (94-96%) and processing speed rather than pixel-wise segmentation metrics; framed as a detection benchmarking study, lacking mIoU/Dice/F1 evidence.
A review of deep-learning models and UAV/satellite remote sensing for aquatic-weed detection in freshwater ecosystems; a survey outside the agricultural crop/weed domain.
A CNN-LSTM-Attention model estimates full-period rice leaf area index from UAV multispectral imagery (R2=0.92); a biophysical trait-regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

A modified multiscale CNN pansharpens Sentinel-2 imagery using UAV data to derive vineyard vegetation indices over multiple seasons; a pan-sharpening/vegetation-index study in a vineyard-fruit domain, not crop/weed segmentation.
A voice-control system pilots drones using a CNN+BiLSTM command recognizer on ESP32; a flight-control/human-interface study, not a computer-vision crop/weed segmentation task.
A review of spray drones for herbicide application, covering operational parameters and weed-detection imaging; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A hybrid CNN-Transformer with Dual-GAN augmentation classifies rice leaf diseases (97.8% accuracy); a disease-classification task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

A lightweight student ViT with token pruning and distillation detects plant diseases on PlantVillage (96.47% accuracy, 1.28M params) for drone monitoring; a disease-classification task, not pixel-level segmentation despite edge-friendly design.

An LLM-enhanced multimodal data-fusion and cascaded-augmentation network performs crop-growth detection/monitoring from UAV remote sensing (F1 91.9%); a crop-detection/data-fusion framework rather than a pixel-level segmentation benchmark.

Feature-reduction machine-learning classifiers (SVM, DT, RF, KNN, LR) and a CNN baseline classify cotton leaf-curl disease (SVM 91% accuracy); a disease-classification task, not pixel-level segmentation.

A three-step classification system (crop classification, disease detection, disease classification) using ViT and EfficientNet-B0 on drone images; an image-classification task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

A comprehensive IoT-AI agricultural-intelligence framework using CNNs, SVMs, and DL regressors for yield prediction, disease diagnosis, and irrigation; a systems/framework study without a crop/weed segmentation benchmark.

A tomato-plant-disease detection study leveraging deep learning and UAV imagery, but no abstract or quantitative results are available; indexing-only entry and a disease-detection task rather than pixel segmentation.

A UAV-tailored Mask R-CNN performs instance segmentation to identify weeds (AP 89.1%) and crops (AP 88.9%) from UAV images with IoT-based alerts; DL UAV crop/weed segmentation with explicit mask AP metrics.

A SegNet semantic-segmentation model segments sorghum panicles, foliage, and ground from UAS field images (94% panicle detection accuracy, Spearman rho=0.88) for high-throughput crop phenotyping; DL UAV crop pixel-segmentation with quantitative accuracy.
ADAMS trains a Mask R-CNN to predict ripe/unripe/dry arecanut from drone images; an arecanut (tree-nut/plantation) classification task in a non-crop/weed domain, not row-crop/weed segmentation.

An overview of digital agriculture (Agriculture 4.0) in fruit production covering monitoring, yield prediction, and autonomous harvesting; a fruit-domain review without a primary crop/weed segmentation benchmark.

MSF-FusionNet, a CNN feature-fusion network, estimates winter-wheat leaf area index from UAV RGB and multispectral imagery (R2=0.8745); a biophysical trait-regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
